output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply and balanceOf[_target] are both incremented without overflow checks, causing a permanent loss of funds in the attackers' accounts.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The assert statement in the _transfer function can be bypassed due to overflow, allowing attackers to increase balances of arbitrary accounts.
The distributeToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[owner] is decremented without overflow checks, causing a permanent loss of funds in the attackers' accounts.

The burn function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply and balanceOf[msg.sender] are both decremented without overflow checks, causing a permanent loss of funds in the attackers' accounts.

The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_from] and allowance[_from][msg.sender] are both decremented without overflow checks, causing a permanent loss of funds in the attackers' accounts.
